message: 神域の小悪魔
The first day of midterms is over, and I head to Asukai Shrine to pay a visit.
I'm trying my best, though maybe because I started studying late, I don't feel as confident as usual.

name: Paqy
message: 「Turning to the gods for help with your tests, huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, I'm not going to ask for good scores. I'm praying for confidence.」

name: Paqy
message: 「You're weirdly meticulous about stuff like that.」

name: Sally
message: 「Okay, okay, everyone line up properly. Hey, you there! Don't push!」

name: Shio
message: 「Indeed, there is no need to rush; there is enough for everyone.」
There are lots of children in the shrine grounds, all lined up neatly in a single row and chatting excitedly.
At the front of the line, right in front of the main hall, sits a folding table with a stockpot on a portable stove. Billowing steam and the smell of piping hot, sweet oshiruko fill the air.

name: Sally
message: 「Look, look! Check out these ladle skills I honed at the beef bowl shop!」

name: Shio
message: 「Splendid. Truly worthy of Lady Sally, who settled in here through Lord Synn's good graces.」
While watching the heat, Sally and Shio ladle oshiruko into bowls and hand them out to the children.
The children sit with their close friends on the torii base, the stage, and the steps of the shrine approach, blowing on the hot oshiruko as they eat.

name: Paqy
message: 「I wouldn't mind getting in on that treat myself.」

name: Sally
message: 「Oh! It's Prez! Hey there!」

name: Shio
message: 「Oh, Lord Synn! Welcome. Please, do get in line.」

name: Synn
message: 「Um... are you sure? Isn't this just for little kids?」

name: Shio
message: 「Nay, this is a sacred rite to serve oshiruko to all worshippers, you know? There are simply many schoolchildren here because of the hour on a weekday.」

name: Sally
message: 「Prez goes to the very back of the line, okay? I can't give you special treatment just because we're friends.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, I know.」
While Sally manages the line and serves the food, about ten minutes pass before I finally get my hands on some oshiruko.

name: Sally
message: 「One regular, coming right up♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks.」

name: Shio
message: 「Now, now, down it in one gulp and accumulate some merit.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh...? Forced chugging? Since I went through the trouble, I'd rather savor it.」

name: Shio
message: 「You see, I was the one who cooked it... so I am not particularly confident in the taste.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Tasty, isn't it? Munch, munch, munch」

name: Sally
message: 「Hey now! Paqy, you didn't say 'thanks for the meal'!」

name: Paqy
message: 「I said it in my heart」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahaha. Well then, including Paqy's share... thanks for the meal! Nom, nom」
Unable to wait any longer, I partake in the hospitality while still standing in front of the two of them.

name: Synn
message: 「You're great, Sally. You properly made everyone wait their turn, didn't you?」

name: Sally
message: 「Hm... hmm? Well, the manager at the gyudon shop taught me all sorts of things」

name: Sally
message: 「Besides, if everyone just eats and makes a mess, cleaning up afterward is a total pain!」

name: Sally
message: 「Wait, grrr! Don't throw your disposable chopsticks there!」

name: Shio
message: 「Indeed! Lady Sally is far more admirable than any half-baked human」

name: Shio
message: 「However... what in the world is a Demon, anyway?」

name: Synn
message: 「...They're no different from us」

name: Shio
message: 「Then I am relieved!」

name: Sally
message: 「I'm back! Shio-chi, there's two servings left. Let's eat too!」

name: Shio
message: 「Understood! I have already dished them out!」

name: Sally
message: 「Yahoo! You're amazing, Shio-chi, making this much oshiruko」

name: Shio
message: 「Nay, for a shrine maiden of Asukai, this is only a matter of course」

name: Sally
message: 「Still, doing it right in the middle of exams is super amazing♪」

name: Shio
message: 「Gulp!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Come to think of it... I'm surprised you had the time to spare」

name: Shio
message: 「W-Well, that is~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, right. You always study steadily on a regular basis, don't you, Shio?」

name: Shio
message: 「I-Indeed! It is the fruit of constant effort」

name: Shio
message: 「As I have given up on exams from the very beginning, I do not panic when the crucial moment arrives!」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Sorry. That sounds kinda weird, honestly」

name: Sally
message: 「Awawawa, you're like, pessimistically positive, Shio-chi」

name: Shio
message: 「Nugugugu... P-Please call it catastrophically bold」

name: Paqy
message: 「Nah, I dunno about that either?」

name: Shio
message: 「P-Please keep this matter a secret from my elder sister...」

name: Sally
message: 「Nom nom nom, phew--that was delicious. Thanks for the meal♪」

name: Sally
message: 「Shio-chi, upupupu」

name: Sally
message: 「I'm gonna go tattle to Misa-Misa. Bye-bye」

name: Shio
message: 「W-What did you say--!? You little imp, halt right there!」
Shio-chan runs off chasing after Sally-chan. A game of tag between a human and a Demon, as if their roles had been reversed.
It looks like it'll take a while before they come back.
I should clean up the stockpot and bowls. It'll be a nice change of pace.
My studying for today's test is sure to go smoothly.
